8.22.1.5.4. iLock_Geography.pispec_configurator.PiSPECConfigurator.store_piinst_rule¶

PiSPECConfigurator.store_piinst_rule(geo_type, pi_type, doc, geo_regexp=None, pi_regexp=None, choice=None)¶

Create and store a PiInstRule in the dictionary managed by piinst_rules.

Parameters:
  • geo_type (str) – The geography subtype.
  • pi_type (str) – The pispec class.
  • doc (str) – Extra documentation for the created rule.
  • geo_regexp (none | str) – Regular expression used by the PiSPECGenerator.
  • pi_regexp (none | str) – Regular expression used by the PiSPECGenerator.
  • choice (none | function) – Function used by the PiSPECGenerator to choose which geography objects of subtype geo_type that should result in a pispec instance and which objects shouldn’t.
Return type:

none
